section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Radio, Stereo Tape Player and Antenna
title: Antenna Motor
ocr_text:
Antenna Motor

INSPECTION OF ANTENNA MOTOR

INSPECT LIMIT SWITCH OPERATION

(a) If the motor stops with the antenna up, check that there is no continuity between terminals 6 and 10.

(b) If the motor stops with the antenna down, check that there is no continuity between terminals 6 and 9.
